name: glass-slider
title: Glass Slider
author: Visant Labs <visantsupply@gmail.com>
description: Slider cuja lente de vidro refrata o fundo enquanto anda. Volume, brilho ou qualquer nível sobre imagem.

.glass-slider-trilho.background: linear-gradient(170deg, color-mix(in srgb, white 9%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, white 15%, transparent))
.glass-slider-trilho.box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, white 26%, transparent), inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, white 34%, transparent)

.glass-slider-lente.-webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, black calc(100% - 0.5px), transparent), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, black calc(100% - 0.5px), transparent), linear-gradient(black 0 0)
.glass-slider-lente.mask-image: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, black calc(100% - 0.5px), transparent), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, black calc(100% - 0.5px), transparent), linear-gradient(black 0 0)
.glass-slider-lente.-webkit-mask-size: var(--h) var(--h), var(--h) var(--h), calc(var(--p) * var(--largura) - var(--h)) 100%
.glass-slider-lente.mask-size: var(--h) var(--h), var(--h) var(--h), calc(var(--p) * var(--largura) - var(--h)) 100%
.glass-slider-lente.-webkit-mask-position: calc((1 - var(--p)) * var(--largura)) 0, 100% 0, calc(calc((1 - var(--p)) * var(--largura)) + var(--h) / 2) 0
.glass-slider-lente.mask-position: calc((1 - var(--p)) * var(--largura)) 0, 100% 0, calc(calc((1 - var(--p)) * var(--largura)) + var(--h) / 2) 0

.glass-slider-anel.background: linear-gradient(100deg, color-mix(in srgb, white 34%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, white 52%, transparent) 62%, color-mix(in srgb, white 80%, transparent) 100%)

uso.quando: Nível contínuo sobre foto ou vídeo, como volume ou brilho em player e painel de casa
uso.evite: Slider em formulário comum: elastic-slider; projeção com conta, sim-slider
